'''Carness''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] who served the [[Balmorran resistance]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. He tasked a Republic [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] to recover data recorders from some crashed Imperial ships. Carness believed that these recorders contained valuable intel on the Empire's planetary defenses.
